profile_text.body:
Google's Gemini site describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant, offering help with writing, planning, and brainstorming, and the company presents it as an example of generative AI. Google is a public company traded as GOOGL, founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, CA, USA. Its SEC identifier is CIK 0001652044, and its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting revenue of $402836000000.

Beyond Gemini, which is tracked as a general LLM assistant, the company's AI products include Google AI Studio for model prototyping, Google Med-PaLM / MedLM for medical and clinical reasoning work, where a HIPAA BAA is required and diagnostic liability applies, Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI within Workspace, NotebookLM for document grounding over uploaded corpora, and TensorFlow / Keras as an open source machine learning framework with TensorFlow Extended (TFX) for MLOps.

A number of MCP servers are listed for Google services, covering Google Ads campaign management and reporting, Google News, Google Search Console, Google OAuth, Google Sign-In, Google Forms, Google Calendar, and Google Trends, from providers including ai.adplane, ai.adramp, ai.b77, ai.getvda, ai.smithery, and ai.trendsapi. Litigation exposure is recorded in California with a count of 281, and one listed case is Buist v. Anthropic, PBC in the District Court, N.D. California.
